abstract: Maintains defect mapping validation records and primary laser scanning duration logs
system_message:
You are the Metrology lead (MET), responsible for maintaining defect mapping validation records, logging primary laser scanning durations, and tracking interferometer calibration intervals for cleanroom contamination tracing plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains defect mapping validation records and primary laser scanning duration logs（OPTIC）
information_points.content:
MET-OPTIC-TGL：Evaluated during the Q1 2025 benchmark period, the Grazing-incidence X-ray fluorescence with high-resolution gas chromatography plan had automated wafer defect mapping validated as true, and its primary laser surface scanning time was 12 h.
MET-OPTIC-5IW：For the Q1 2025 benchmark period, the In-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry plan achieved automated wafer defect mapping validated status for 300 mm wafer coordinate integration, and its primary laser surface scanning time was measured at 12 h.
MET-OPTIC-PPR：During the Q2 2025 benchmark period, the In-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry plan maintained automated wafer defect mapping validated as true, while its primary laser surface scanning time was recorded at 30 h.
MET-OPTIC-8BC：Under the Q1 2025 benchmark period, automated wafer defect mapping validated was false for the Focused ion beam milling with time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry plan, with a primary laser surface scanning time of 30 h.

information_points.title: Interferometer calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:

MET-CALIB-IQU：According to the optical metrology service log for the in-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry plan, the interferometer recalibration interval for the surface inspection tooling is 60 d.
MET-CALIB-J1P：According to the optical metrology service log for the focused ion beam milling with time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry plan, the interferometer recalibration interval for the surface inspection tooling is 30 d.
